text:
maria_support: FYI customer C-7723 reporting lots of 503s + huge token billing increase since 03:20 UTC. They say client sets x-rw-region: eu-west-1 but traces show requests handled in us-east-1 and latency jumps. Can someone check gateway/Envoy?

alex_infra: looking. On initial skim I see retries from the L7 layer kicking over to a fallback cluster in us-east and the x-rw-region header is missing on the retried request. Suspect header drop on retry path.

sanjay_runtime: repro steps I used locally:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redact>" -H "x-rw-region: eu-west-1" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Response (from capture):
```
<-  HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
<-  x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 532
<-  x-rw-handled-cluster: gw-eu-primary
<-  x-rw-retried-cluster: gw-us-fallback
```
Notice: header on retried request shows gw-us-fallback and x-rw-region absent.

lisa_eng: that matches a config bug I tripped over last week. When Envoy applies automatic retry, it can clone the original request but some custom headers end up in the mutations chain (header_rewrite or remove_headers) for the fallback cluster. If region-affinity header isn't in the preserved set it will be dropped.

maria_support: Customer says this started after a config rollout ~03:15 UTC. Could be a recent gateway cluster tag change.

ops-bot: ALERT: billing-spike C-7723 03:22 UTC — tokens billed +8x for gw-us-fallback (detected by charge-monitor) :rotating_light:

alex_infra: pulled the rollout diff — deploy 2026-03-15:gw-rewrite added: 
```
clusters:
  - name: gw-us-fallback
    per_request_header_transform:
      remove: ["x-rw-region", "x-rw-tenant-id"]
```
Oof — that remove list is global for fallback cluster. If Envoy retries to that cluster the header will be removed.

sanjay_runtime: repro to show header drop in access log:
```
access_log: {
  method: POST, path: /v1/generate, req_headers: {authorization, user-agent}, extra: {x-rw-region: eu-west-1}
}
... on retry ->
access_log: {
  method: POST, path: /v1/generate, req_headers: {authorization, user-agent}, extra: {}
  upstream_cluster: gw-us-fallback
}
```
So routing affinity lost -> request lands in us-east -> higher latency and token count (longer prompt expanded).

lisa_eng: immediate mitigation options:
- Option A (fast): remove x-rw-region from remove list on gw-us-fallback and roll it out (patch cluster config).
- Option B (safer short-term): disable automatic retriable actions for gateway on 5xx (set retry_policy: {retry_on: ""}) to avoid transparent fallback.
- Option C: add preserve_headers: ["x-rw-region"] for cluster clone/retry paths.

james_support: what is risk of rolling change for Option A? Customer impact window?

alex_infra: Option A is low-risk config change. We'll patch via k8s configmap update and force reload on the gateway pods. Rollout plan: patch -> 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m observation. Command: 
```
kubectl -n gateway patch configmap gw-clusters --type merge -p '{"data": {"gw-us-fallback.yaml": "...remove: []..."}}'
```
I'll run canary on 2 nodes first.

maria_support: while infra does that I'll draft a customer note: explain we see gateway retry behavior dropped region header causing cross-region failover and added latency/billing. ETA for fix?

ops-bot: Deploy job started by alex_infra @ 1799994360 :rocket:

alex_infra: rolled patch to 5% at 1799994372. Metrics watcher: error-rate for C-7723 down 70% but some traces still show gw-us-fallback. Investigating sticky sessions/entropy header.

sanjay_runtime: additional weirdness — when fallback path runs we are also injecting an x-gw-entropy header at the load balancer for sharding. If that header arrives and upstream routing has a header_based_route with higher precedence it can move traffic to us-east even if x-rw-region present. Need to ensure x-rw-region has higher precedence or is honored in fallback.

lisa_eng: noted. Long-term fix: reorder route matcher to prefer x-rw-region affinity; short-term keep preserve_headers for retries. I'll open a PR to make preserve_headers explicit and add tests for retry cloning.

james_support: customer comms ready. Please confirm 100% rollback or fix ETA.

alex_infra: moving to 50% at 1799994380. So far stable. If 10m looks good we'll complete.

maria_support: thanks everyone. I'll send the note now and include repro steps we used and the mitigation (disable retry or preserve header).

ops-bot: Deploy completed 100% at 1799994390 :white_check_mark:

alex_infra: post-deploy verify: access logs show x-rw-region preserved on retried requests and gw-us-fallback no longer strips it. Will keep monitoring for 2h.

maria_support: customer replied: reduced errors and latency, thanks. Marking as resolved for now, will escalate if it reappears. :thumbsup:
